title: Targeting Module
summary: Component used to craft the Hellfire Engine Crossbow.

fields.Crafting: Combine this module with the Watcher Crossbow Blueprint and Steel Watcher Arm at the foundry’s assembly table.
fields.Acquisition: On the main floor of Steel Watch Foundry, by the Watcher Targeting Module plaque at X −307, Y −157.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
